plugins.name: ace
plugins.description: v7.1.11: Budget-verbatim injection render: top-N patterns by bandit_rank injected VERBATIM until ~9,500-char budget, tail dropped entirely (no compact index), drops domains_summary/expanded/threshold bloat. Fits CC 10K additionalContext cap so curated patterns actually reach the model inline. Safety valve drops whole patterns (never raw-truncates, always valid JSON). F-080 scoped to injected top-N. No floor bump. v7.1.10: Bugfix: PostToolUse domain-shift hook emitted invalid JSON (hand-rolled sed escaping corrupted strings with quotes/unicode/newlines; CC silently dropped injections). Replaced with jq -n --arg (matches safe pretooluse pattern). No floor bump. v7.1.9: Drop domain-shift --allowed-domains filter: server-confirmed domain_match anti-predicts relevance. Cross-domain patterns now surface; basename-only query; --top-k 8 retained; empty-basename guard; de-confounded bandit_rank. No floor bump. v7.1.8: Server-blessed injection render refactor: bandit_rank best-first ordering, stop hard-dropping reward<0/isAtRisk patterns (0 drops / higher recall), tiered output (top-15 verbatim + compact ranked index), drop expanded cache-warming array, central ace_pattern_render.py helper wired into all 4 injection sites. -78% injection tokens on live prod. F-080 retrieval tracking preserved. No floor bump. v7.1.7: /ace:ace-graph polish: isolated/disconnected nodes hidden by default with "Show isolated nodes" toggle + header meta-bar showing connected/isolated counts. No floor bump. v7.1.6: Bugfix: /ace:ace-graph project-name resolution. No floor bump. v7.1.5: Command de-stale + ACE-1.5 insights + new knowledge-graph command. No floor bump. v7.1.4: Concurrent-subagent degenerate-trace fix. No floor bump. v7.1.3: Subagent session-anchoring correctness + SubagentStop observability. No floor bump. v7.1.2: Injection quality + correctness hardening. Floor bump: ace-cli >= 4.1.2, @ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2. v7.1.1: Domain-shift session-pinning + strip/gate hardening. v7.1.0: Per-agent ACE attribution. Requires: Claude Code >= 2.1.163, ace-cli >= 4.1.2 (@ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2).
